_about: Crux Tập 2 · C3 final (direction D2 = H2 'geometry of interest' + H3 'history timeline', chosen per beat; one colour set, one font). Channel/ep001 tokens unchanged (episodes/ep001/design/c3/final/tokens.json); Episode 2 adds the E2 aliases 'costlier' and 'cushion' (owner C3, 2026-10-01) that REPLACE negative/positive for data marks in this episode. Type sizes are px at 1920x1080; smallest text 48 px (floor 40 px, G-014), readable at 25%.

episodeAliases._rule: E2 (owner C3). In Episode 2 every data mark meaning 'costlier in total' uses costlier, every mark meaning 'cushion/saving' uses cushion; positive/negative are not used for data in this episode. costlier is 3.3:1 on bg, so it is never a text colour (numbers stay ink).

roles.text-secondary: ink-muted (lesson D5: words next to an emphasised number)
roles.tbill: accent: the ridge (T-bill history) as a line + 16% area; never Leah, never a result
roles.fixed: ink-muted level rail, 10 px at 1080; never moves
roles.leah: ink + DIAMOND (with a bg keyline). Her variable rate path is an ink line with the diamond at its head; in KEY-1 she is an ink person figure with a diamond cut-out on the chest
roles.above-fixed: warn: the rail segment / area where the variable rate is above 9%; a reversed head start (variable starts above 9%) is warn. Never on the same object as costlier
roles.costlier: costlier #C72323: result cells, share bars (with bg diagonal seams = second channel), the extra-interest block. Always BELOW a zero/base line or inside a bin
roles.cushion: cushion #269783: area below the rail, the jar/tank, the head-start bracket/wedge. Solid fill (no seams)
roles.head-start: cushion bracket/wedge between rail and Leah's start (warn when reversed)
roles.eras: two bins directly under the two halves of the ridge, split by an ink-muted dashed line at 1981-01
roles.offer-card: bg card, 5 px ink-muted border, folded top-right corner (KEY-1 only)
roles.badge: warn background, bg text: ILLUSTRATIVE, top right, on every frame that shows Leah's loan
roles.masked: surface #171B22 flat block over each text ink box (+3 px), drawn by the MASK flag in the build

hero.use: the one number of the beat
